configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: LAN Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will operate as a LAN server: no heartbeat, no authentication, and no non-class C addresses

configurationFields.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
configurationFields.description: Sets the [Steam Game Server Login Token](https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers) for the server, otherwise the server's ranking will be impacted in the server browser. Use app ID 4000 when generating the token

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Initial Gamemode
configurationFields.description: Sets the [gamemode](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=4000&searchtext=&childpublishedfileid=0&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&requiredtags%5B%5D=Gamemode&created_date_range_filter_start=0&created_date_range_filter_end=0&updated_date_range_filter_start=0&updated_date_range_filter_end=0) to start the server with. You can use another gamemode by selecting "Custom" and specifying the gamemode in Custom Gamemode. The gamemode must be in 'garrysmod/gamemodes' or 'garrysmod/addons'

configurationFields.label: Custom Gamemode
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom gamemode to use for the Initial Gamemode, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the [map](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=4000&searchtext=&childpublishedfileid=0&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems&requiredtags%5B%5D=Map&created_date_range_filter_start=0&created_date_range_filter_end=0&updated_date_range_filter_start=0&updated_date_range_filter_end=0) to start the server with. You can use another map by selecting "Custom" and specifying the map in Custom Map. The map must be in 'garrysmod/maps' or in a workshop collection downloaded under Workshop Collection ID

configurationFields.label: Custom Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected. Must be a map appropriate for the specified Initial Gamemode

configurationFields.label: Map Game Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time per map. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Workshop Collection ID
configurationFields.description: Sets the ID of a [Steam workshop collection](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=4000&browsesort=trend&section=collections) to download and load on the server

configurationFields.label: Resource Lua Code
configurationFields.description: Sets the [code](https://www.yourdevtools.com/gmod/workshop) to force players to automatically download the corresponding workshop collection addons when connecting

configurationFields.label: CSS Content Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how to handle Counter Strike: Source content for the server. Update the server after changing this setting (unless "Do nothing" is selected)

configurationFields.label: TF2 Content Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets how to handle Team Fortress 2 content for the server. Update the server after changing this setting (unless "Do nothing" is selected)

configurationFields.label: Server Region
configurationFields.description: Sets the server region shown in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Allow Spectators
configurationFields.description: If set, spectator mode will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Pure Server Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether clients are only allowed to use certain files

configurationFields.label: Enable Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheat convars will be allowed to be used on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable IP Packet Filter
configurationFields.description: If set, enables packet filtering by IP mode. If disabled, everyone will treated as IP-banned, but their IP won't be added to the banlist

configurationFields.label: Loading URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL to show to clients while joining the server. Must start with http:// or https://

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content from the server (maps, sprays and related)

configurationFields.label: Fast Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for clients to download custom content from, instead of sourcing the content from the server. This allows for faster downloads

configurationFields.label: Allow Upload To Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to upload customisation files to the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum Upload File Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowed file size for uploading to the server

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable bandwidth rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit

configurationFields.label: Minimum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Maximum Server Update Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of updates per second of the positions of the server's models (players, guns, etc) that server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Decal Frequency
configurationFields.description: Sets the time between decal sprays

configurationFields.label: Ping Boost
configurationFields.description: Selects between optimised network code stack. Setting at 2 usually reduces latency toward 1ms without loss of activity input packets

configurationFields.label: Log Chat Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, logging of chat messages will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Disable Valve Anti-Cheat
configurationFields.description: If set, Valve Anti-Cheat (VAC) will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Server/RCON IPv4 IP Binding
configurationFields.description: If required, you can change the IPv4 IP binding of the server and RCON by changing the Application IP Binding for this instance. NOTE: GSCS requires the server to be bound to a specific IP, rather than 0.0.0.0, for the server to log to GSCS's console. The IP must also be reachable by GSCS

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line parameters (anything that begins with a -) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [console variables](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/List_of_Garry%27s_Mod_console_commands_and_variables) (anything that begins with a +) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care. Preferably, specify the equivalent under "Additional Server Settings"

configurationFields.label: Additional Server Settings
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional settings to include in "server.cfg" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. One setting per line

configurationFields.label: Advanced/Power User Server Settings
configurationFields.description: For advanced/power users, specifies additional settings to include in "server.cfg" that override any settings set by GSCS in that file. One setting per line. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, friendly fire will be enabled (teammates can cause damage to other teammates)

configurationFields.label: Enable Flashlight
configurationFields.description: If sets, allows the use of the flashlight by pressing the F button

configurationFields.label: Enable Footsteps
configurationFields.description: If set, footstep sounds will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Crosshair
configurationFields.description: If set, the auto crosshair will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Players To Pause Server
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to pause the server. Not recommended

configurationFields.label: Allow All Talk
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players can communicate with all other players, with no team restrictions

configurationFields.label: Enable Fade To Black
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a player's screen fades to black for the remainder of the round after death (HUD and chat still works)

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Kick
configurationFields.description: If set, automatic team-killer banning and idle client kicking will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable God Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, god mode will be enabled for all players, making them invincible

configurationFields.label: Allow Player-to-Player Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to hurt each other

configurationFields.label: Enable Noclip
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to use noclip

configurationFields.label: Maximum Noclip Speed
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum speed a player can move during noclip

configurationFields.label: Noclip Acceleration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed at which a player accelerates during noclip

configurationFields.label: Enable Weapons
configurationFields.description: If set, players will receive default Half-Life 2 weapons on each spawn

configurationFields.label: Maximum Props
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum props a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ragdolls
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ragdolls a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum NPCs
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum NPCs a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Balloons
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum balloons a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Cameras
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum cameras a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Effects
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum effect props a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Dynamite
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum dynamites a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Lamps
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum lamps a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Lights
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum lights a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Thrusters
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum thrusters a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Wheels
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum wheels a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Hoverballs
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum hoverballs a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Vehicles
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum vehicles a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Buttons
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum buttons a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Entities
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum entities a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Maximum Emitters
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum emitters a single player can create

configurationFields.label: Disable SourceTV
configurationFields.description: If set, SourceTV will be disabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Enable Automatic Demo Recording
configurationFields.description: If set, all games will be recorded as SourceTV demos

configurationFields.label: SourceTV Viewer Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients allowed to connect to the server's SourceTV. 0 = no SourceTV viewers are allowed, the game will only be recorded locally

configurationFields.label: Maximum SourceTV Bandwidth
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum SourceTV spectator bandwidth rate allowed. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Serverversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the server branch to install. NOTE: Update the server after switching branches!
